audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Akshan Level 1 and Level 6 and gave Shen Levels 3 and 4-5, while the whys under those rows say the opposite: whys[0] states neither side has a kill threat, whys[2] and whys[3] say Akshan owns levels 3-5, whys[4] says Stand United flips the lane at 6. Packet levelChart is Skill, Skill, Akshan, Akshan, Shen, Shen, Shen.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] told the player Spirit's Refuge blocks Avengerang. Riot's text for Refuge blocks ATTACKS only — Avengerang is a spell and goes straight through the zone.
audit.why: Refuge does answer the part of Akshan that is autos: his passive fires an extra reduced-damage attack per auto and every third hit shields him. That is the real value, and the false spell-block would get a player killed standing in the zone.
audit.corrected: wants.you[1] now names autos and the passive second shot as what Refuge eats, and states Avengerang passes through. dosFull[0].d carries Heroic Swing's 18s rank-1 cooldown plus the body-block knock-off.

audit.why: Heroic Swing at 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s is the punishable cooldown and the text already schedules around it.
